_doc: pla-06 (owner-approved playability plan 2026-11-20, Ice/Freeze/Chilled/Petrify merge): copy that supersedes the protected historical records. Ice Exposes 2 a unit that enters it or starts its turn on it; Chilled, Freeze and Petrify are cut; former Freeze cards print their own Stagger; Petrify is Stagger 6. Loaded with pla04_burst_copy.json by tests/burst_glossary_contract.py.

relic_descriptions.frost_prism: When your @term(element_ice) attack @term(stagger|Staggers) an enemy on @term(surface_ice), leave @term(surface_rubble) under and beside the struck enemy.
relic_descriptions.cold_mirror: When your @term(element_ice) card @term(stagger|Staggers) an enemy while you have 4+ @term(block), trade all your @kw(block) for 1 @term(frost_armor) layer per 4, up to 2.
relic_descriptions.rimecatcher_vial: When your @term(element_ice) attack @term(stagger|Staggers) an enemy on @term(surface_ice), you can move the Ice 1 tile.
relic_descriptions.hobnail_cleats: @term(surface_ice) doesn't @term(expose) you. While you stand on @term(surface_ice), your @term(element_ice) attacks deal 2 more damage.
relic_descriptions.breaking_wheel: Enemy collision: @kw(surface_consume) the ground. @term(surface_fire): 3 more damage. @term(surface_ice): @kw(stagger) 6. @term(surface_electrified): @term(shock) enemy and enemy blockers. @term(surface_rubble): @kw(stagger) 3.
relic_descriptions.starless_astrolabe: While you have @icon(truesight), applying @icon(stagger) with Ice or applying @icon(shock) creates @icon(illuminate) {radius} @icon(time) {duration} beneath that enemy.

glossary_definitions.expose: This unit takes that much extra damage from the next damaging hit.
glossary_definitions.surface_ice: Units gain Expose 2 when entering Ice or starting a turn on Ice.
glossary_definitions.skate: This turn, Ice costs no Movement and doesn't Expose you.
glossary_definitions.element_ice: Ice is the card element associated with Ice ground.
glossary_definitions.frostbite: Frostbite hits everyone standing on Ice when the battlefield rule triggers.

combat:cleanse: Cleanse removes the listed statuses from you at once: Bleed, Immobilize or Shock. Removing Immobilize or Shock frees you for the rest of this turn, and a Shock cleanse can be played while Shocked.
combat:health_defense: Non-piercing damage is applied to Block first, then Stoneskin, then Health.
Block clears before that actor's turn-start Fire damage. Stoneskin persists and can absorb it.
Damage hits Block first, then Stoneskin, then Health. Pierce skips Block and Stoneskin.
combat:stances: Skate: this turn, moving onto Ice costs no Movement and Ice doesn't Expose you.
Immobilize: for the rest of this turn you can't Move, Blink or Swap, including your own movement.
Anchored: until your next turn, Push and Pull against you move you 0 tiles and never collide.
Fireproof: Fire doesn't damage you this turn.
Active stances appear as badges on your character.
Push, Pull and Wind don't move it or cause a Collision. Yours lasts until your next turn.
combat:surface_techniques: Expend: a card that Expends a ground removes the shown ground to gain its effect. A Burst destroys ground instead (see Burst).
Convert: Frost Circuit turns the chosen Ice tile and all Ice connected to it into Electrified ground, then strikes and Shocks each enemy on the converted tiles.
Discharge: choose an Electrified tile to Burst it and every Electrified tile connected to it.
Wards leave a ground beneath each enemy next to you. Ice placed this way Exposes an enemy on entry or at the start of the enemy’s turn.
combat:sweeping_strikes: Some cards strike every enemy you can see that meets a condition: standing on Fire, Ice or Electrified ground, or in Light. There is no target to choose, and an enemy hidden by the Umbra is never hit.
Each strike is a direct hit of the card's element. The card can be played only while at least one enemy qualifies.
Hit every enemy you can see that meets the shown condition, within Range if shown. No target to choose.
enemy:frostglass_lancer: Ice striker that creates Ice tiles. Refract Guard clears Ice beneath the Lancer.
enemy:iskaldra: Ice dragon protected by visible Crystal Mantle layers, with Rime Spitters laying Ice around it.
When Iskaldra uses Rime Talon, Frostbite hits everyone on Ice for 3. At half Health, Frostbite hits after every second Iskaldra turn instead. Break Mantle layers to shrink Shatterstorm's reach.
keyword:collision: When forced movement is stopped by a wall, crate, Outcrop, character or illusion, the target takes 2 damage for each tile it didn't move, and so does whatever it hit. Walls take nothing.
Block and Stoneskin absorb Collision damage without an Expose bonus.
A stopped Push or Pull deals 2 damage per lost tile to the target and to its blocker.
keyword:element_ice: Ice is the card element associated with Ice ground.
keyword:retaliate: Until the start of your next turn, an enemy whose melee attack hits you takes the Retaliate amount. Block and Stoneskin absorb Retaliate damage without an Expose bonus.
Melee means a melee attack or any attack made from a tile next to you. Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack. Several Retaliates add their damage and Bleed; Shock and Push use the largest.
An enemy defeated by Retaliate pays its normal rewards but does not refund a Card Play.
Until your next turn, each enemy that hits you up close takes that much damage and the listed effects.
an illusion's Retaliate triggers once per enemy attack.
keyword:skate: This turn, stepping onto Ice costs no Movement, and Ice doesn't Expose you.
keyword:surface_ice: Units gain Expose 2 when entering Ice or starting a turn on Ice.
keyword:stagger: Delays the target's next turn by this much Time.
Hover a target to preview the delay, capped at 6 Time per enemy each turn.

battlefield_sentences.snare_ice: After each of your turns, Frostbite hits everyone on Ice for 1.
